report_summary: A particularly substantive, carefully bounded report: it traces explicit acknowledgments and corrections, deletion-aware backup creation, limited timestamp precision, correlated XSS-related saves, and the difference between task pressure and proven score effects. It preserves positive and negative evidence and expressly separates export consistency from authenticity. No clear substantive overstatement was identified in the scoped propositions.
